lines: When a ride opens a new map, Results celebrates it.
A gold card names the map, says where it rides, and offers to ride it: Neon Docklands is open.
It is the one moment the app moves. The card fades in and grows, then its photo comes into colour. With reduced motion, it only fades.
The backend decides. A top three finish against bots opens the next map, stars open another, and level ten opens Vice City. It names the map once.
When nothing opened, there is no card.
On a phone the card leads what you earned, below the standings. From a tablet in landscape, it sits beside them.
What the tests prove: every unlock rule, the answer through the API, and the card and its motion.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
